fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground ('Single Site: $12 per night', 'Group Site: $85 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234558/rates (Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $12, GROUP $85), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The 21 single sites are first-come, first-served; only the two group sites book on recreation.gov (4 months ahead; reservations carry a 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum). 14 nights a month. Limit 3 camping units and 2 vehicles per site; all equipment must fit on the site. No cell reception.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground ('This campground has first-come, first-served sites. All equipment must fit on the space provided. Limit 3 camping units and 2 vehicles per single campsite.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234558 (rules maxStay 14 'Each Month', reservationWindow 4 Months, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234558 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites reservable false, 2 GROUP sites reservable true), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground (Seasons of Use: 'April - Labor Day Weekend'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 21 single sites plus two group sites (20-35 people); every site is listed at 21 ft, back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234558 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 2 GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 21 on all, Driveway Entry Back-In) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234558 ('The three group campsites range in capacity from 20 to 35 guests'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234558 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (every site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC / GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Drinking water: recreation.gov says 'seasonal drinking water, which is available April through October'; the Forest Service page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234558 ('Amenities include vault toilets and seasonal drinking water, which is available April through October.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups) and day use fees.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: $12 single / $85 group, first-come single sites (only group sites reservable), 14 nights a month, no electric, 21 sites all listed at 21 ft back-in, vault toilets, Senior/Access 50% off. Added season April - Labor Day weekend. The two official pages disagree on drinking water (recorded in facilities.note, potable_water left unset). Note left as is (AWH firsthand).
flags: Site length (criteria, human decides): recreation.gov's catalog lists every site at Max Vehicle Length 21 ft, and the Forest Service says 'All equipment must fit on the space provided'; under the ~22-23 ft floor. AWH's own note already says 'All sites claim to accommodate 21 feet RVs but will probably handle a few feet more.'
Missing phone: recreation.gov gives 540-279-4144; the Forest Service page gives the James River and Warm Springs Ranger District, 540-839-2521.
Conflicting official pages on drinking water: recreation.gov 'seasonal drinking water ... April through October' vs Forest Service 'Potable water is not available at this site.'
